lookForward.fits: National Poetry Day is Thursday 1 October 2026.
lookForward.headline: National Poetry Day on Thursday
lookForward.line: Poems on the radio, in schools and stuck to lampposts. Find one you liked at fourteen and read it again on Thursday. It has probably improved.

onThisDay.fits: 28 September 1928: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin at St Mary's Hospital, London.
onThisDay.headline: Penicillin was discovered in a London hospital, by accident
onThisDay.line: Fleming returned to St Mary’s, Paddington, to a mouldy dish with a clear ring where bacteria had died. He looked instead of washing up.

kindness.text: Write four lines for someone this week. They do not have to rhyme. They have to be about them.

joke.setup: What did Fleming say to the mouldy dish?
joke.punchline: You're not going in the sink. You're going to Stockholm.

riddle.riddle: I grew on a forgotten dish in London, and I have saved more lives than any doctor. What am I?
